intro: Five visible stages, each ending with a concrete decision or deliverable.

items.title: Understand
items.summary: We establish the goal, facts, constraints and project boundary.
items.output: A shared brief, source inventory and risk list.

items.title: Frame
items.summary: We define positioning, structure and success criteria.
items.output: An approved direction, sitemap and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Design
items.summary: We shape identity, UX/UI and meaningful states.
items.output: A visual and interaction system ready for review.

items.title: Build & Connect
items.summary: We implement the site and agreed integrations.
items.output: A working test release with documented connections.

items.title: Verify & Handover
items.summary: We test, launch and hand over the knowledge needed to run the system.
items.output: Quality-check results, source files, access map and operating notes.
